entities.name: Thrissik
entities.description: One of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia who seeks the Destroyer and wants to be the Father of Machines.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: Thane attacked and substantially injured by Thrissik.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader to whom Thrissik pledged allegiance.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: Group of Thanes of New Phyrexia.

events.summary: After Roxith comes to Thrissik's realm to harvest flesh, Thrissik attacks him to test whether he is the destroyer, injures him, and concludes he is not.
events.quote: Thrissik managed to substantially injure Roxith and concluded he was not the "destroyer".

events.summary: Thrissik pledges allegiance to Elesh Norn and builds cairns from strong mages to bring about his Destroyer.
events.quote: Thrissik is one of the Thanes who pledged their allegiance to Elesh Norn .

relations.quote: Thrissik is one of the the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia .
pledged their allegiance to Elesh Norn
Thrissik attacked the Thane in order to determine if he was the "destroyer"
